title: Sunflower Fatty Acid Stability GWAS: analysis code
description: Analysis code for a genome-wide association study of seed fatty acid composition and its stability in the sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.) association mapping population across eight North American environments. Includes phenotype preparation, Eberhart and Russell beta stability estimation, CHELSA climate extraction and correlation, genotype and kinship analysis, multivariate GEMMA and univariate vcf2gwas runs, post-GWAS candidate gene identification, and chromosome 5 introgression analysis.
